results.title: Avengers Doomsday: Hugh Jackman Teases Deadpool-Wolverine's Return, Shares THIS Message For Kevin Feige
results.description: Ryan Reynolds recently shared a video of Hugh Jackman in which he expressed his wish to be a part of Avengers: Doomsday. Ryan and Hugh have played Deadpool and Wolverine in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).
